sampling: One snapshot after constraint solve, before integration, at every eighth substep, including reset. Relative velocities precede current force integration.
force_convention: force acts on link_b; normal force = -force dot collision normal
utilization: (abs(F dot d1)+abs(F dot d2))/(mu*Fn), using the pinned solver orthogonals; ignore near-zero Fn when interpreting ratios.
qualification: Observer only. Must reproduce all saved reference arrays before diagnostic use. No physical coefficient measurement; contact rows are dependent samples.
